<thought>We need to place a CO₂ molecule on the TiO₂ slab at a height of ~2 Å. The provided adsorption site JSON is empty, so we’ll use the default placement (no specific site). The original CO₂ CIF caused parsing errors, so we’ll construct a minimal valid CO₂ CIF string that the tool can parse. After adding the adsorbate, we’ll write the combined structure to a CIF file and return its path.</thought>
<action>add_adsorbate_to_slab_text</action>
